categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Supertech Advanced Material Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of vacuum insulation panels (VIP) and insulation boxes. The company also develops vacuum glass products and high-barrier films, serving mainly the home appliance and cold chain logistics sectors. Its subsidiaries focus on related materials and new applications such as building insulation and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary technologies in core materials formulation, barrier film production, adsorbent preparation, vacuum packaging, and performance testing of vacuum insulation panels. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including shell-type four-edge sealing technology and airflow netting for core materials. The firm also develops automated production equipment and testing instruments to ensure product quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international home appliance manufacturers such as Haier, Midea, Samsung, LG, and Bosch, primarily serving the refrigerator and freezer markets. The company also supplies medical, biological, and food cold chain logistics sectors with insulation boxes. Emerging markets include new energy vehicle battery thermal management, building insulation, LNG equipment, and high-temperature insulation applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Fujian and Anhui provinces and sales covering domestic and international markets including South Korea, Japan, Europe, and the Americas. Its products are supplied to manufacturing bases of global appliance brands worldwide, with increasing domestic sales proportion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fujian Supertech operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of key insulation materials and components. It controls core upstream processes such as raw material preparation and barrier film production, enabling integrated production and quality control. Downstream, it supplies to appliance manufacturers and cold chain logistics providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to enhance product performance, reduce costs, and expand applications. Key R&D directions include new core materials, high-barrier films, shell-type sealing processes, and vacuum glass technology. It also focuses on automation, intelligent manufacturing, and expanding into new markets like energy storage, building insulation, and LNG. Talent development and establishing postdoctoral research platforms are strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized sales of vacuum insulation panels and insulation boxes to appliance manufacturers and cold chain logistics companies. Sales are conducted via direct sales and through authorized intermediaries, with pricing based on product specifications, performance, and market conditions. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns on financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic and global player in the vacuum insulation panel industry, competing with specialized manufacturers like Sichuan Maikelong and Chuzhou Yinxing, as well as in-house producers at large appliance brands such as Mitsubishi and Panasonic. It holds a strong market position due to advanced technology, scale, and stable relationships with top-tier customers. It actively participates in industry standard setting and is recognized as a technology leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 933.5 million, an 11.16% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 77.16 million, a 27.27% decrease due to increased costs and investment losses in subsidiaries. Total assets reached nearly RMB 2 billion with a stable asset-liability ratio around 43%. The company maintains steady growth with significant R&D investment accounting for over 5% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fujian Supertech offers high-performance, low thermal conductivity vacuum insulation panels with superior energy-saving and space-saving properties compared to traditional insulation materials. Its integrated production chain ensures stable quality and cost advantages. The company differentiates through continuous innovation in materials, manufacturing processes, and expanding applications into emerging sectors like new energy batteries and green building. Its products comply with international environmental standards, supporting global energy efficiency and carbon reduction goals.
